> 第二十六章 丹赛之后（第1页）
冯斗此时马上凝聚自己最强的灵气形成了最强的防御力，他当然非常之清楚地知道以自己的能力来说，根本就不可能抵挡得住第三道丹雷。
但是他最终还是不甘心不尝试就直接放弃了，他已经暗中通知幻仙准备好，一旦出现他抵挡不住的，他连忙出手。
毕竟他还没有完全自负到觉得自己真的能够对付得任何的东西，正是因此他才让幻仙作为二手准备。
此时空中的丹云汇聚在一起，闪电不断地翻滚，仿佛随时都有可能会有丹雷劈下来一样，正是这样就更加冯斗的额头不由得暗暗地皱起来，因为他感觉到这头顶上的丹雷远远地超过他的能力最大范围。
焦伢看到这一番丹雷时，他的内心不由得灵机一转，他脑中不由得泛起曾经一番景象，那就是三年前，他有幸目睹了他的师父“太岳丹臣”炼制一枚臣级丹药，引发丹雷，可是单纯这一点来说，也是和现在差不多。
他心里不由得道：怎么可能的呢？他现在连民级丹药都算不上，但是为什么炼制出来的丹雷要和师父臣级丹药所炼制出丹药的丹雷差不多呢？莫非我看错了，他现在就已经超过臣级丹药了吗？
可是他现在不敢再想下去，他越想越害怕，这点根本就不是他能够控制得了的。
就在此时一道丹雷从天而降，冯斗这次并没有被动挨打，反而主动进攻了，他将灵气打向空中，居然能够与第一道丹雷相对抗，最后还是相抵消了。
单纯这一点就已经让众人大吃一惊，因为此时的丹雷已经不是刚刚的那些丹雷，无论从毁坏力还是从强度方面，都不是刚刚那些丹雷能够相比较的。
就这样让众人对于冯斗真正的实力有了更加深的体会，表面上冯斗的修为是仙机四段初阶，但是真正的实力来说却堪比仙机六段巅峰的实力也不为过的。
这一点超出众人所料，当然是有人欢喜有人愁的，因为焦伢此时真的搞不清楚应该高兴还是担忧，他担心冯斗的出现会影响到自己家族的地位。
毕竟一代纪元天才的出现，必定会引起不一般的影响，曾经有一位纪元天才出现，被一位无上境的大师收为徒弟，最后却是让他身后的家族因此提升了，真的是一人得道鸡犬升天。
最后他得道之后，毁掉了曾经诋毁他家族的五大家族，然而此时的焦伢就根本不知道是否应该去巴结冯斗，还是应该怎么样啊！
对于冯斗这样的天才必定会在大赛之后，受到各家族的追捧，这一点是不需要质疑的，但是现在他现在拉拢一下冯斗，可不是他能够干扰得了的。
就在焦伢在犹豫的时候，第二道丹雷已经降下来，冯斗再次运起最强灵气，希望可以能够挡住第二道丹雷，结果却是让他有点失望了。
第二道丹雷击破了冯斗的防御，直接击中冯斗，然而此时的冯斗被击飞，同时口吐鲜血，他一直飞出了三里之外才真正地停下来。
他慢慢地稳住自己的脚步之后，他居然能够屹立不倒啊！
众人看到这一刻时候，都已经认为冯斗就算不被丹雷击杀，也是会被丹雷击中重伤，可能还会因此而道销灵除，但是却超出众人的所意料之外啦！
现在冯斗轻轻地擦一下嘴角的鲜血，他此时感觉自己全身仿佛灌铅一样，他知道自己已经接近自己的极限，但是他还希望自己能够突破一下自己的极限，不然就没有这样的绝好机会啦！
冯斗继续凝聚自己的灵气，准备迎接最后的一击丹雷，只有抵挡住了最后一击的丹雷，这颗丹药才能够真正凝聚成丹，只有这样冯斗才能够真正地成功。

> Chapter 26 After the Danzai (Page 1)
At this time, Feng Dou immediately gathered his strongest spiritual energy to form the strongest defense. Of course, he knew very clearly that based on his own ability, it was impossible to withstand the third pill thunder.
But in the end, he was unwilling to give up without trying. He had secretly informed Huanxian to be ready. If there was something he couldn't resist, he would take action quickly.
After all, he was not completely conceited enough to think that he could really deal with anything. That was why he had Huanxian as a second-hand preparation.
At this time, the pill clouds in the sky gathered together, and the lightning continued to roll, as if a pill thunder might strike down at any time. This made Feng Dou's forehead wrinkle secretly, because he felt that the pill thunder above his head was far beyond the maximum range of his ability.
When Jiao You saw this elixir, he couldn't help but have an idea in his heart. He couldn't help but recall a scene from the past, that is, three years ago, he was lucky enough to witness his master "Taiyue Danchen" refining a minister-level elixir to trigger the elixir. However, in terms of this aspect, it was almost the same as now.
He couldn't help but thought: How is this possible? He is not even considered a civilian-level elixir now, but why is the elixir he refines almost the same as the elixir refined from his master's minister-level elixir? Could it be that I misunderstood that he has surpassed the level of minister-level elixir now?
But he didn't dare to think about it anymore. The more he thought about it, the more scared he became. This was something he couldn't control at all.
At this moment, a pill thunder fell from the sky. Feng Dou did not passively take the beating this time, but took the initiative to attack. He shot his spiritual energy into the air and was able to compete with the first pill thunder, and finally canceled it out.
This alone has surprised everyone, because the Dan Lei at this time is no longer the ones just now. In terms of destructive power and intensity, it is not comparable to those Dan Lei just now.
In this way, everyone has a deeper understanding of Feng Dou's true strength. On the surface, Feng Dou's cultivation is at the beginning of the fourth stage of Immortal Ji, but in terms of real strength, it is comparable to the peak strength of the sixth stage of Immortal Ji.
This was beyond everyone's expectation, and of course some people were happy and others were worried, because Jiao You really couldn't figure out whether he should be happy or worried at this time. He was worried that Feng Dou's appearance would affect his family's status.
After all, the emergence of an epochal genius will definitely have an unusual impact. There once was an epochal genius who appeared and was accepted as a disciple by a supreme master. In the end, the family behind him was promoted as a result.
After he finally gained enlightenment, he destroyed the five major families that had slandered his family. However, at this time, Jiao Ya didn't know whether he should curry favor with Feng Dou or what to do!
There is no need to doubt that a genius like Feng Dou will be sought after by various families after the competition, but now that he is trying to win over Feng Dou, it is not something he can interfere with.
Just when Jiao Ya was hesitating, the second Dan Lei had already descended. Feng Dou used his strongest spiritual energy again, hoping to block the second Dan Lei, but he was a little disappointed.
The second Dan Lei broke through Feng Dou's defense and hit Feng Dou directly. However, at this time, Feng Dou was knocked away and vomited blood at the same time. He flew three miles away before he really stopped.
After he slowly stabilized his steps, he was actually able to stand firm!
When everyone saw this moment, they all thought that even if Feng Dou was not killed by the Dan Lei, he would still be seriously injured by the Dan Lei, and he might even die because of it, but it was beyond everyone's expectation!
Now Feng Dou gently wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth. He felt as if his whole body was filled with lead. He knew that he was close to his limit, but he still hoped that he could break through his limit, otherwise he would not have such a perfect opportunity!
Feng Dou continued to condense his spiritual energy, preparing for the final strike of the pill thunder. Only by withstanding the final strike of the pill thunder could the pill be truly condensed into a pill. Only in this way could Feng Dou truly succeed.
